Introduction

LuxeRank ("we" or "our") respects your privacy，and is committed to protecting your personal information。Privacy Policyexplains how we collect、use、store and protect your personal information，andthe rights you enjoy。

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Information:When you subscribeournewsletter、Contactor participate in surveys，We may collect yourName、email addressAddressand other information。
  • Technical Information:We use cookies and other tracking technologies to collect your browsing data, including IP address, browser type, access time, and more.
  • Affiliate Marketing Data:We use third-party analytics tools to track your purchasing behavior for commission calculations.

How We Use Your Information

We use collected information for the following purposes:

  • Provide and improve our services

Information Sharing

We will not sell your personal information. We may share information with the following third parties:

  • Affiliate marketing partners (e.g., Amazon Associates)

Your Rights

Under privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, you have the following rights:

  • Access personal information stored in our system
  • Request correction of inaccurate personal information
  • Request deletion of your personal information
  • Object to processing of your personal information
  • Data portability right
